story.i_want: circuit breaker implementations to prevent cascading failures when external AI services (LLM providers, vector databases) experience outages or degradation
story.so_that: the AI Multi-Agent System remains partially operational during external service failures, failing gracefully instead of blocking or crashing

acceptance_criteria.description: Implementation includes three states: CLOSED (normal operation), OPEN (failing fast), and HALF_OPEN (testing recovery)
Circuit breaker tracks failure_count, success_count, last_failure_time, and total_calls with thread-safe operations
All state transitions and statistics updates are protected by locks to handle concurrent access
Both synchronous CircuitBreaker and asynchronous AsyncCircuitBreaker are provided
LLMCallWrapper class provided to wrap LLM service calls with circuit breaker protection
ChromaDBWrapper class provided to wrap vector database queries with circuit breaker protection
circuit_breaker_decorator and async_circuit_breaker_decorator for easy function wrapping
CircuitBreakerManager provides registry and centralized access to multiple circuit breakers
All tests pass verifying state transitions, thread safety, and edge cases

open.description: Failing fast, requests are immediately rejected with CircuitBreakerError

failure_threshold.description: Number of consecutive failures before opening circuit

recovery_timeout.description: Seconds to wait before attempting recovery (transition to HALF_OPEN)

half_open_max_calls.description: Maximum calls allowed in HALF_OPEN state before confirming recovery

success_threshold.description: Number of successes needed in HALF_OPEN to close circuit

use_cases.failure_mode: API timeout, rate limiting, service unavailable
use_cases.protection: Prevents system from hanging on LLM calls, returns error quickly

use_cases.failure_mode: Connection timeout, query timeout, server unavailable
use_cases.protection: Prevents RAG pipeline from blocking, allows fallback to cached results
Allows graceful degradation while other services continue

alert_recommendations: Alert when circuit transitions to OPEN
Alert when circuit remains in OPEN state beyond expected recovery
Track circuit breaker health in system dashboard
